Trial balance.question: The _____ was List of all business accounts in a ledger.
Trial balance.fact: A trial balance is an internal financial statement that lists the adjusted closing balances of all the general ledger accounts (both revenue and capital) contained in the ledger of a business as at a specific date. The debit balance values will be listed in the debit column of the trial balance and the credit value balance will be listed in the credit column.

Trial balance.subject: Accounting & Auditing
Trial balance.question: For example, if a cash sale for £100 is debited to the _____ account, and credited to the Cash account
Trial balance.fact: For example, if a cash sale for £100 is debited to the Sales account, and credited to the Cash account.
